'''R4-P44'''<ref name="SWTVE" /> was a [[R4-P Astromech]] that was assigned to [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s [[212th Attack Battalion|clone trooper forces]] while stationed on [[Utapau]].<ref name="Episode III" /> The [[droid]], like [[R4-P17]] and [[R4-G9]], had the dome of a [[R2-series astromech droid|R2 unit]].<ref name="SWTVE" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Droids visually identical to R4-P44 appear in ARC-170 bombers on [[Coruscant]] and [[Cato Neimoidia]] during the course of ''Revenge of the Sith'', but it is never shown on Utapau as is described in several sources.

The name was confirmed to be [[canon]] by the reference book ''[[Star Wars: R2-D2 Deluxe Book and Model Set]]'', a [[2016]] model set with an accompanying reference book written by [[Michael Kogge]].<ref name="IncrediBuilds" /> 

R4-P44 appears in the [[Canon|non-canonical]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' as one of the three possible droids for [[Temmin Wexley|Snap Wexley]] to rebuild and use during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]].<ref name="LSWTFA">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> [[LEGO]] included R4-P44 in the [[2025]] version of the ARC-170 Starfighter,<ref name="LEGO 2015">{{LEGOCite|num=75402|name=ARC-170 Starfighter}}</ref> after it had already appeared in the version released in [[2010]].<ref name="LEGO 2010">{{LEGOCite|num=8088|name=ARC-170 Starfighter}}</ref>
